scope: Primary and official guidance reviewed for the current audit; applicability is recorded separately from implementation verification.

decisions.title: RFC 9110 §9.2.2
decisions.recommendation: Automatic retry of a non-idempotent method needs knowledge that its semantics are idempotent or that the original request was not applied.
decisions.applicability: Checkout, event commands and Mobile mutation retries
decisions.rationale: Bind retries to immutable actor/resource/request receipts; retain ambiguous outcomes. Do not enable blanket POST retries.

decisions.title: RFC 9700 OAuth 2.0 Security Best Current Practice
decisions.recommendation: Constrain OAuth tokens and protect public-client refresh tokens with sender constraint or rotation.
decisions.applicability: External OAuth adapters and future refresh-token flows
decisions.rationale: Audit each actual OAuth flow. TDF opaque API tokens are not automatically an OAuth authorization server; this source does not certify current sessions.

decisions.title: OWASP Authorization Cheat Sheet
decisions.recommendation: Deny by default and check authorization on every request.
decisions.applicability: Role composition, object ownership and receipt replay
decisions.rationale: UI hiding is discovery only; backend denial and authorization on replay require executable cases.

decisions.title: WHATWG Fetch: CORS protocol and credentials
decisions.recommendation: Credentialed sharing requires an origin-specific response and explicit credentials permission.
decisions.applicability: Observed reflected origin plus credentials in production
decisions.rationale: An origin-specific response is insufficient if arbitrary origins are reflected. AUTH-CORS-001 restricts the trusted origin set. CORS does not replace CSRF or resource authorization.

decisions.title: PostgreSQL 17 range constraints
decisions.recommendation: Exclusion constraints can enforce non-overlapping ranges.
decisions.applicability: Exclusive resource reservations on production PG17
decisions.rationale: Prefer transactionally enforced exclusion constraints for resource/time conflicts; application prechecks alone do not prevent races. Inspect each actual booking path before claiming coverage.

decisions.title: PostgreSQL 17 transaction isolation
decisions.recommendation: Isolation levels provide distinct visibility/conflict behavior; serializable failures require whole-transaction retry.
decisions.applicability: Revision fencing, concurrent grants, reservations, worker claims
decisions.rationale: Run actual PostgreSQL race tests and distinguish isolation assumptions. Do not retry external effects merely because the database transaction retries.

decisions.title: Stripe idempotent requests
decisions.recommendation: Provider idempotency binds repeated calls to a key with provider-specific retention and parameter rules.
decisions.applicability: Stripe adapter and local checkout receipts
decisions.rationale: Retain local immutable request/effect evidence beyond provider key retention. Provider keys do not establish universal exactly-once processing.

decisions.title: PayPal REST requests
decisions.recommendation: PayPal-Request-Id supports idempotency only for supported APIs and their documented retention behavior.
decisions.rationale: Verify endpoint support and exact request binding, preserve ambiguous outcomes and reconcile using authenticated provider evidence.

decisions.title: Lamport: A high-level view of TLA+
decisions.recommendation: Specify system behavior mathematically and check properties at an explicit abstraction level.
decisions.applicability: Existing TLA+/TLC models and implementation correspondence
decisions.rationale: Record state bounds, environment/fairness and exclusions; use negative controls and separate concrete runtime evidence. Bounded model checks do not prove the whole implementation.

decisions.title: NIST SP 800-63B-4 Authenticator Event Management
decisions.recommendation: Recovery requires authenticating recovery evidence, not merely supplying known contact attributes.
decisions.applicability: Public artist claim and account recovery
decisions.rationale: A caller-typed public email is not possession proof. Use independent signup and reviewed delegated management; no NIST assurance-level certification is claimed.

decisions.title: PostgreSQL 17 explicit locking
decisions.recommendation: Row locks persist to transaction end; blocked locking reads return the current row. Lock mode compatibility and ordering determine concurrency behavior.
decisions.rationale: Party NO KEY UPDATE precedes credential and token mutation. Avoid an inner commit and revalidate after waits. Real database races remain required.

decisions.title: OWASP Forgot Password Cheat Sheet
decisions.recommendation: Bind recovery tokens to individual accounts, make them single-use and expire after an appropriate period.
decisions.applicability: ID-SESSION-003 recovery expiry and immutable credential binding
decisions.rationale: 900 seconds is an explicit TDF policy, not a mandated OWASP duration. Rate limiting, hashed storage, delivery guarantees and separate post-reset login remain independent conformance gaps.

decisions.title: PostgreSQL 17 current date/time functions
decisions.recommendation: clock_timestamp reads actual current time; now and CURRENT_TIMESTAMP use transaction start time.
decisions.rationale: Sample actual database time after lifecycle locks and floor UTC seconds consistently with the test adapter. Transaction-start time could accept a token expired while blocked.

decisions.title: Debian apt-secure(8)
decisions.recommendation: Authenticate archive metadata and reject repositories that lose authentication; insecure repository overrides undermine this chain of trust.
decisions.applicability: Backend build and runtime image package installation
decisions.rationale: Remove existing insecure overrides. This protects APT archive authenticity; it does not prove installed packages or upstream images free of vulnerabilities.

decisions.title: Debian bookworm apt-get(8) error-on option
decisions.recommendation: Use --error-on=any on update to fail even on transient errors.
decisions.applicability: Fail-closed image builds when a mirror or proxy fails
decisions.rationale: Authenticated cached indexes alone do not establish a successful refresh; stop the build and diagnose infrastructure.

decisions.title: PostgreSQL 17 aggregate functions
decisions.recommendation: sum(bigint) returns numeric, preserving exact aggregate arithmetic.
decisions.rationale: Compare an exact numeric aggregate before any fixed-width conversion; do not wrap financial totals.

decisions.title: PostgreSQL constraint trigger semantics
decisions.recommendation: Deferrable constraint triggers can validate at transaction end or SET CONSTRAINTS.
decisions.applicability: Parent followed by multiple immutable checkout lines in one transaction
decisions.rationale: Allow transactional construction but reject incomplete commits. Concurrency relies separately on immutable amounts and nonnegative lines, not on deferral alone.

decisions.title: PostgreSQL17 mathematical functions: div
decisions.recommendation: div(numeric,numeric) computes the integer quotient, truncating toward zero.
decisions.applicability: Nonnegative merchandise commission floor calculation at Int64 boundaries
decisions.rationale: Actual counterexample: trunc(maxInt64::numeric*5000/10000) rounds to4611686018427387904, whereas the exact floor is4611686018427387903. div preserves the required quotient without a rounded intermediate.
